items.headline: Nvidia shares soar more than 30% after Huang reinstated as CEO
items.summary: Nvidia shares soared more than 30% Monday and had their third-best day on record after the company announced it reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO and president, effective immediately.

items.headline: Nvidia sets options-trading record after CEO comeback. Here are the big trades
items.summary: Nvidia break record for single stock options volume

items.headline: Asian stocks rally as Huang's Nvidia return revives AI trade
items.summary: Asian shares saw significant gains as Nvidia's CEO Jensen Huang made a return that relieved market fears. The MSCI Asia-Pacific index rose by 4.6%, while Japan's Nikkei gained 4.5% after a local holiday. This movement followed a 31.5% surge in Nvidia shares, revealing optimism in the beleaguered AI sector. United States Treasury yields climbed alongside the dollar, signaling increased confidence in Fed tightening measures.

items.headline: Jensen Huang is ‘too big to fire,’ putting Nvidia’s governance in focus: analysts
items.summary: Jensen Huang’s return has underscored Nvidia’s deep reliance on its founder, putting the company's board oversight and corporate governance under scrutiny.

items.headline: Amazon faces FAA probe after delivery drone strikes Michigan fiber cable, garage
items.summary: An Amazon drone "struck a fiber cable, a residential garage, and became entangled in power lines during takeoff," a preliminary FAA report stated.

items.headline: Iran says three tankers hit mines in Hormuz despite U.S. escort, as Treasury widens sanctions
items.summary: Iran said three oil tankers caught fire after hitting naval mines in the Strait of Hormuz, as the U.S. escalates sanctions aimed at cutting off Tehran's financial lifelines.

items.headline: Big Tech could face billions of dollars in fines under Australian internet safety bill
U.S. stock futures steady after Nvidia-led Wall Street rally
items.summary: Investing.com-- U.S. stock futures were little changed on Monday evening following a powerful rally on Wall Street driven by Nvidia's decision to reinstate founder Jensen Huang as chief executive.

items.headline: AI adoption grows in Asia, but measuring the gains remains tricky
items.summary: Businesses across Asia-Pacific are seeing returns from AI investments, even as confidence in measuring those gains varies, according to an AWS survey.

items.headline: China has changed tactics but is still thwarting India's rise, a U.S. panel says
items.summary: China is increasingly focused on containing India economically rather than through military actions.

items.headline: Nvidia's board was no match for Trump or powerful backers of Jensen Huang
items.summary: Trump said he spoke directly and indirectly with Nvidia directors and believed his intervention was crucial to Jensen Huang's reinstatement, raising questions about the board's independence

items.headline: U.S. court orders to proceed with planned ammunition detonation in Iowa
items.summary: A U.S. court cleared the Army to detonate degraded explosives at an Iowa ammunition plant amid public concern over contamination and health risks.

items.headline: Nvidia shares soar 31% as Jensen Huang's return sparks Wall Street rally
items.summary: Nvidia's rally lifted the Nasdaq 100 by 6.5% and the S&P 500 by 4.7%, while shorter-dated Treasury yields and the dollar climbed on bets of a more hawkish Fed

items.headline: Six key questions raised by Jensen Huang's return to Nvidia
items.summary: As Jensen Huang returns to Nvidia, questions remained around the board's reversal, Trump's involvement and the tech giant's future.

items.headline: U.S. adds Megaspeed to trade blacklist over export control concerns amid Nvidia controversy
items.summary: The U.S. has added Megaspeed and six other companies to its trade blacklist over concerns about the potential diversion of advanced computing products.

items.headline: Asian Nvidia-related stocks jump after Huang's return, with Taiwan's near price limits
items.summary: Investors piled back into the tech market, following the reinstatement of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang by its board.

items.headline: CrowdStrike CEO defends Zscaler acquisition, calls it a 'winning combination'
items.summary: CrowdStrike CEO George Kurtz defended the company's $44 billion acquisition of Zscaler.

items.headline: Trump sealed deal for Nvidia to rehire Jensen Huang as CEO
items.summary: President Trump said his administration gave Nvidia's board assurance that Jensen Huang would not be a national security threat if he was reinstated as CEO.

items.headline: Jim Cramer sees more upside for Nvidia stock with Jensen Huang back as CEO
items.summary: CNBC's Jim Cramer said Jensen Huang's return as Nvidia CEO could help revive the chipmaker's battered stock.

recs.market_summary: El S&P 500 (SPY) está en Stage 4 bajista con solo 3/7 señales técnicas OK. Los índices QQQ y DIA también en Stage 4. El rally de NVDA (+31.5%) por el regreso de Jensen Huang no alcanza para revertir la tendencia general. Noticias geopolíticas negativas (Irán, ciberataques) presionan al mercado. Los ADRs argentinos están débiles, cerca de mínimos de 52 semanas. Solo AAPL y MSFT están en Stage 2 alcista, pero MSFT con señales mixtas. Recomendación general: cautela, evitar compras agresivas, esperar confirmación de Stage 2 en los índices.
